text:
Claire Nguyen: Quick async thread: partner syndication landing going live tomorrow. Need a minimal SEO playbook: canonical strategy across partner copies, redirect fallbacks for old affiliate links, schema for webinar + registration, and a 5-item internal-link plan. Can we lock owners? @Diego @Priya

Diego Morales: I'll own canonical and redirects. My take: partner clones should use rel=canonical pointing to /product/leadflow if content is largely duplicate. For high-value partners we can do self-canonical + canonical-link HTTP header pointing to partner canonical and a separate canonicalized partner URL mapping in Search Console via linked properties.

Priya Patel: I'll own JSON-LD + FAQ + rich result monitoring. Plan: Event JSON-LD for webinar, WebPage schema for partner landing, and a small FAQPage mainEntity for registration Qs. I'll put snippets in /docs/seo/snippets.

Maya Lin: I'll handle internal links. Quick shortlist: add contextual links from: /docs/ingest (anchor: "set up inbound lead routing"), /integrations/slack ("Slack integration for Leadflow"), /partners/onboard ("Partner lead routing setup"), /support/troubleshoot ("routing troubleshooting"), /pricing/compare ("Leadflow pricing"). I'll add owners in the sheet.

OpsBot: Deploy checklist created: [redirects, canonical headers, JSON-LD, internal links, sitemap ping]. Assigned owners: Diego, Diego, Priya, Maya, Claire.

Diego Morales: Redirect snippet for edge (staging as 302, then 301):
```nginx
# legacy affiliate -> canonical product
rewrite ^/affiliates/lead-early/?$ /product/leadflow? redirect;
# strip common tracking params at CDN/edge before caching
```
Also: ensure CDN cache key excludes utm_* and ref params so we don't index duplicates.

Priya Patel: JSON-LD (Event + FAQ condensed):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Leadflow webinar: routing at scale","startDate":"2026-09-09T10:00:00-07:00","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/leadflow"},"offers":{"@type":"Offer","url":"https://redwood.ai/register/leadflow","availability":"https://schema.org/InStock"},"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```
FAQ snippet (example):
Q: How do I register? A: Click Register -> fill form -> confirm email.
Q: Which integrations work? A: Slack, HubSpot, Segment.
Q: Can I change my registration? A: Yes, via the confirmation email link.

Claire Nguyen: Canonical decision: for partner microsites with unique intro copy (<20% unique), we canonicalize to /product/leadflow. For partners who provide truly unique use-cases or co-branded deep content, allow self-canonical but request reciprocal linking to /product/leadflow. Diego, confirm how we'll enforce via headers.

Diego Morales: Confirmed. We'll add Link: <https://redwood.ai/product/leadflow>; rel=canonical header at the app edge for partner clones that we control. For external partner domains, we'll add a canonical meta tag in the partner template snippet we provide and ask partners to adopt it; otherwise we'll rely on 301s from affiliate paths.

Maya Lin: Internal link micro-tasks (owners):
- /docs/ingest -> Claire (anchor: "set up inbound lead routing")
- /integrations/slack -> Jordan (anchor: "Slack integration for Leadflow")
- /partners/onboard -> Partner Ops (anchor: "partner lead routing setup")
- /support/troubleshoot -> Support (anchor: "routing troubleshooting")
- /pricing/compare -> Growth (anchor: "Leadflow pricing")
I'll update the sheet and add due = deploy + 2h.

Priya Patel: Monitoring plan: ping Search Console for URL inspection after sitemap push, track impressions & rich result presence for 14 days, and set an alert for sudden drops in impressions >30% in 48h. Also will A/B FAQ collapsed vs inline on partners page for two weeks to measure CTR.

Diego Morales: Found one leftover 302 in old mapping that would cause a loop if we deploy naive 301s. I'll add a guard in the redirect map to detect loop patterns and send to staging queue. OpsTeam FYI.

Claire Nguyen: Small copy ask: H1 should be exact-match primary keyword "Inbound lead routing" on canonical article. Partner copies can use natural variants but include first paragraph with primary keyword close to start.

Priya Patel: Adding breadcrumb schema to blog and partner templates too, helps context in SERP.

Maya Lin: I'll also add anchor recommendations to the partner outreach doc so partner managers can request link placements.

Diego Morales: Rollout plan: stage redirects (302) + header injection and JSON-LD in templates -> smoke tests -> swap redirects to 301 and remove staging flag -> sitemap push + Search Console ping. Timing: target midnight deploy, +2h smoke and +24h signal review.

Claire Nguyen: Sounds good. Everyone confirm by EOD? If anything blocks, post in #marketing-urgent. Thanks all :rocket:

Priya Patel: Confirmed. Snippets in /docs/seo/snippets and PR linked.

Maya Lin: Confirmed. Sheet updated and owners assigned.

Diego Morales: Confirmed. Redirect PR opened to staging branch. Running smoke in 10m.

OpsBot: Thread closed (automated).
